guess_property_metadata: guess metadata for all properties in an ASE atoms list including info and calculator results
guess_target_metadata: guess the shape, type, and extensivity metadata for a set of target samples given atom lengths
target_extensive: determine whether a property is intensive or extensive by checking per-atom normalized variation
target_per_atom: check whether a target is per-atom by verifying the first dimension matches the number of atoms
target_constant_shape: check whether target samples have a constant shape regardless of varying atom counts
